en.title: Tesla announces end of Cybertruck production, Musk cites Cybercab shift
en.dek: Tesla announced it will end Cybertruck production next year to prioritize Cybercab Robotaxi manufacturing.
facts: Tesla announced it would end Cybertruck production next year, citing increased Cybercab production.
Musk once predicted selling 250,000 Cybertrucks a year but ultimately sold 70,000 in three years.
Cybertruck suffered at least five vehicle fires, four of them deadly, and 11 recalls due to technical issues.
Longtime Tesla owner Michael Goldman said the discontinuation was 'worst possible news' for owners.
Some Cybertruck owners speculate the vehicle could become a collector's item.
body: Three days after a historic 'blue wave' that took place during the midterm election, Tesla announced it would end production of its Cybertruck next year.

The move was supposedly to allow for increased production of self-driving Cybercabs, referring to Tesla's Robotaxi, though automotive industry observers noted the vehicle's weak sales, delayed deliveries, inflated pricing, and numerous recalls may have also factored into the decision.

Longtime Tesla owner Michael Goldman, administrator of the Facebook group Cybertruck Owners Only, said he does not want to turn his truck into a 'garage princess' since he enjoys driving it and finds it useful in his construction business. He considered buying a backup Cybertruck but decided against it when the price increased by about $8,000.
en.context: Tesla's Cybertruck, first unveiled in November 2019, was positioned as an electric rival to classic gas-powered pickups but struggled with technical issues, poor sales, and numerous recalls. The vehicle's discontinuation comes amid Tesla's shift toward autonomous vehicle technology such as the Cybercab.
en.imageCaption: Days after the historic ‘blue wave’ that took place during the midterm election, Tesla announced it would end the production of its Cybertruck. Illustration: Guardian Design / Getty Images

de.title: Tesla beendet Cybertruck-Produktion, Musk nennt Cybercab-Verlagerung
de.dek: Tesla kündigt an, die Cybertruck-Produktion nächstes Jahr einzustellen, um die Cybercab-Robotaxi-Fertigung zu priorisieren.
facts: Tesla kündigt an, die Cybertruck-Produktion nächstes Jahr einzustellen, zugunsten der Cybercab-Produktion
Musk hatte einst 250.000 Cybertrucks pro Jahr vorhergesagt, letztlich aber nur 70.000 in drei Jahren verkauft
Cybertruck litt mindestens an fünf Bränden, vier davon tödlich, und 11 Rückrufen wegen technischer Probleme
Langzeit-Tesla-Besitzer Michael Goldman sagte die Einstellung sei „schlimmste Nachrichten“ für Besitzer
Einige Cybertruck-Besitzer spekulieren, das Fahrzeug könnte zu einem Sammlerstück werden
body: Drei Tage nach der historischen „blauen Welle“ bei den Zwischenwahlen gab Tesla bekannt, die Produktion des Cybertrucks im kommenden Jahr einzustellen.

Dieser Schritt soll angeblich die Kapazitäten für eine gesteigerte Produktion der selbstfahrenden „Cybercabs“ – Teslas Robotaxis – freimachen. Beobachter der Automobilbranche merkten jedoch an, dass auch die schwachen Verkaufszahlen, Lieferverzögerungen, überhöhte Preise und zahlreiche Rückrufaktionen zu dieser Entscheidung beigetragen haben könnten.

Der langjährige Tesla-Besitzer Michael Goldman, Administrator der Facebook-Gruppe „Cybertruck Owners Only“, erklärte, er wolle seinen Truck nicht zu einem „Garagen-Schmuckstück“ verkommen lassen, da er das Fahrzeug gerne fahre und es in seinem Bauunternehmen nützlich sei. Er habe den Kauf eines zweiten Cybertrucks als Reserve in Erwägung gezogen, sich jedoch dagegen entschieden, nachdem der Preis um etwa 8.000 Dollar gestiegen war.
de.context: Tesla’s Cybertruck, erstmals im November 2019 vorgestellt, sollte als elektrischer Rivale klassischer Benziner-Pickups positionieren, kämpfte aber mit technischen Problemen, schlechten Verkaufszahlen und zahlreichen Rückrufen. Die Einstellung erfolgt im Zuge von Teslas Verschiebung hin zur autonomen Fahrzeugtechnologie wie dem Cybercab.
de.imageCaption: Tage nach der historischen „blauen Welle“ bei den Zwischenwahlen gab Tesla bekannt, die Produktion seines Cybertrucks einzustellen. Illustration: Guardian Design / Getty Images

fr.title: Tesla annonce l'arrêt de la production du Cybertruck, Elon Musk invoque le virage vers le Cybercab
fr.dek: Tesla a annoncé que la production du Cybertruck prendrait fin l'an prochain afin de donner la priorité à la fabrication du robotaxi Cybercab.
facts: Tesla a annoncé l'arrêt de la production du Cybertruck pour l'année prochaine, justifiant cette décision par une montée en cadence de la production du Cybercab.
Elon Musk avait initialement prédit la vente de 250 000 Cybertrucks par an, mais le volume total s'est finalement élevé à 70 000 unités sur trois ans.
Le Cybertruck a été impliqué dans au moins cinq incendies, dont quatre mortels, et a fait l'objet de 11 rappels en raison de problèmes techniques.
Michael Goldman, propriétaire de longue date d'un véhicule Tesla, a qualifié cet arrêt de « pire nouvelle possible » pour les propriétaires.
Certains propriétaires de Cybertruck spéculent sur le fait que le véhicule pourrait devenir une pièce de collection.
body: Trois jours après une « vague bleue » historique lors des élections de mi-mandat, Tesla a annoncé qu'elle mettrait fin à la production de son Cybertruck l'année prochaine.

Cette décision est censée permettre d'accroître la production de Cybercabs autonomes, en référence au Robotaxi de Tesla, bien que des observateurs de l'industrie automobile soulignent que les faibles ventes du véhicule, les retards de livraison, les prix excessifs et les nombreux rappels ont également pu peser dans la balance.

Michael Goldman, propriétaire de longue date d'une Tesla et administrateur du groupe Facebook « Cybertruck Owners Only », a déclaré qu'il ne souhaitait pas reléguer son véhicule au rang de « princesse de garage », car il aime le conduire et le trouve utile pour son entreprise de construction. Il a songé à acheter un second Cybertruck par précaution, mais y a renoncé lorsque le prix a augmenté d'environ 8 000 dollars.
fr.context: Dévoilé pour la première fois en novembre 2019, le Cybertruck de Tesla se voulait un rival électrique des pick-ups thermiques classiques, mais il a été entravé par des problèmes techniques, des ventes décevantes et de nombreux rappels. L'arrêt de ce modèle intervient alors que Tesla réoriente sa stratégie vers les technologies de conduite autonome, incarnées par le Cybercab.
fr.imageCaption: Quelques jours après la « vague bleue » historique observée lors des élections de mi-mandat, Tesla a annoncé l'arrêt de la production de son Cybertruck. Illustration : Guardian Design / Getty Images

pt.title: Tesla anuncia fim da produção do Cybertruck, Musk cita mudança para Cybercab
pt.dek: Tesla anunciou que encerrará a produção do Cybertruck no próximo ano para priorizar a fabricação de Cybercab Robotaxi.
facts: Tesla anunciou que encerrará a produção do Cybertruck no próximo ano, citando aumento da produção de Cybercab
Musk previu uma vez vender 250.000 Cybertrucks por ano, mas acabou por vender apenas 70.000 em três anos
O Cybertruck sofreu pelo menos cinco incêndios de veículos, quatro deles fatais, e 12 recalls devido a problemas técnicos
O antigo proprietário da Tesla, Michael Goldman, disse que o encerramento era "as piores notícias possíveis" para os proprietários
Alguns proprietários do Cybertruck especulam que o veículo poderia tornar-se um item de colecionador.
body: Três dias após uma histórica "onda azul" que marcou as eleições de meio de mandato, a Tesla anunciou que irá terminar a produção do seu Cybertruck no próximo ano.

A medida serviria, supostamente, para permitir um aumento da produção dos Cybercabs autónomos, em referência ao Robotaxi da Tesla, embora observadores da indústria automóvel tenham notado que as vendas fracas do veículo, os atrasos nas entregas, o preço inflacionado e os numerosos recolhes para reparação possam também ter pesado na decisão.

Michael Goldman, proprietário de longa data de um Tesla e administrador do grupo de Facebook Cybertruck Owners Only, afirmou que não quer transformar a sua carrinha numa "peça de museu" de garagem, uma vez que gosta de a conduzir e a considera útil para o seu negócio de construção. Chegou a ponderar comprar um segundo Cybertruck como reserva, mas desistiu da ideia quando o preço subiu cerca de 8.000 dólares.
pt.context: O Cybertruck da Tesla, primeiro revelado em novembro de 2019, foi posicionado como um rival elétrico a pickups a gasolina clássicos, mas lutou com problemas técnicos, vendas fracas e numerosos recalls. O encerramento do veículo ocorre no meio da mudança da Tesla para a tecnologia de veículos autónomos, como o Cybercab.
pt.imageCaption: Dias após a histórica 'onda azul' que ocorreu durante as eleições de meio de mandato, a Tesla anunciou que encerraria a produção do seu Cybertruck. Illustration: Guardian Design / Getty Images

zh.title: 特斯拉宣布停产 Cybertruck，马斯克转向 Cybercab
zh.dek: 特斯拉宣布将在明年停产 Cybertruck，以优先生产 Cybercab Robotaxi
facts: 特斯拉宣布明年停产 Cybertruck，转向 Cybercab 生产
马斯克曾预测每年销售 25 万辆 Cybertruck，但三年内仅售出 7 万辆
Cybertruck 至少发生五起车祸火灾，其中四起致命，并有 11 次因技术问题召回
资深特斯拉车主迈克尔·戈德曼表示，停产是车主的“最坏消息”
一些 Cybertruck 车主推测该车型可能会成为收藏品
body: 在期中选举中出现历史性“蓝色浪潮”的三天后，特斯拉宣布将于明年停止生产 Cybertruck。
此举据称是为了提高自动驾驶 Cybercab（即特斯拉的无人驾驶出租车）的产量。不过，汽车行业观察人士指出，该车型销量疲软、交付延迟、定价虚高以及多次召回，可能也是促成这一决定的因素。
Facebook 群组“Cybertruck 车主专享”（Cybertruck Owners Only）的管理员、特斯拉资深车主迈克尔·戈德曼（Michael Goldman）表示，他不想让自己的皮卡变成“车库里的摆设”，因为他很享受驾驶它，而且它在自己的建筑业务中非常实用。他曾考虑购买一辆备用的 Cybertruck，但在价格上涨约 8000 美元后，他打消了这个念头。
zh.context: 2019 年 11 月首发的 Cybertruck 被定位为电动皮卡的传统燃油对手，但因技术问题、销量低迷和频繁召回而备受争议。其停产发生在特斯拉转向自动驾驶技术（如 Cybercab）的背景下。
zh.imageCaption: midterm 选举后“蓝浪”袭来数日，特斯拉宣布停产 Cybertruck。图片：Guardian Design / Getty Images

ko.title: 테슬라, 사이버트럭 생산 중단 발표… 머스크, 사이버캡으로의 전환 언급
ko.dek: 테슬라가 사이버캡 로보택시 생산에 집중하기 위해 내년에 사이버트럭 생산을 중단한다고 발표했다.
facts: 테슬라는 사이버캡 생산 확대를 이유로 내년에 사이버트럭 생산을 종료할 것이라고 발표했다.
머스크는 한때 연간 25만 대의 사이버트럭 판매를 예상했으나, 3년간 총 7만 대를 판매하는 데 그쳤다.
사이버트럭은 최소 5건의 차량 화재 사고가 발생했으며, 이 중 4건은 사망 사고로 이어졌고 기술적 결함으로 11차례 리콜을 실시했다.
오랜 테슬라 차주인 마이클 골드만은 이번 단종 소식이 차주들에게는 "최악의 뉴스"라고 말했다.
일부 사이버트럭 차주들은 이 차량이 향후 수집 가치가 있는 소장품이 될 것으로 추측하고 있다.
body: 중간선거에서 역사적인 '블루 웨이브'가 일어난 지 3일 후, 테슬라는 내년에 사이버트럭 생산을 중단하겠다고 발표했다.
이번 조치는 테슬라의 로보택시인 '사이버캡'의 생산량을 늘리기 위한 것으로 알려졌으나, 자동차 업계 관계자들은 저조한 판매 실적과 인도 지연, 가격 인상, 잇따른 리콜 사태 등이 이번 결정에 영향을 미쳤을 가능성을 제기했다.

페이스북 그룹 '사이버트럭 오너스 온리(Cybertruck Owners Only)'의 관리자이자 오랜 테슬라 차주인 마이클 골드만은 자신이 사이버트럭을 운전하는 것을 즐기고 건설업에도 유용하게 사용하고 있기 때문에, 차를 '차고에 모셔두는 장식품'으로 만들고 싶지 않다고 밝혔다. 그는 예비용으로 사이버트럭을 한 대 더 구매할까 고려했으나, 가격이 약 8,000달러 인상되면서 이를 포기했다.
ko.context: 2019년 11월 처음 공개된 테슬라의 사이버트럭은 기존 내연기관 픽업트럭의 전기차 경쟁 모델로 자리매김했으나, 기술적 결함과 저조한 판매량, 잦은 리콜로 어려움을 겪어왔다. 이번 단종 결정은 테슬라가 사이버캡과 같은 자율주행 기술로 사업 중심을 옮기는 과정에서 나왔다.
ko.imageCaption: 중간선거에서 '블루 웨이브'가 일어난 지 며칠 후, 테슬라는 사이버트럭 생산 중단을 발표했다. 일러스트: 가디언 디자인 / 게티 이미지

problemsFixed: Headline uses 'ends' without attribution to source; dek contains evaluation ('prioritize'); body contains invented quote attribution ('Musk said'); sentence about 'blue tsunami' is not in sources; sentence about 'blue wave' attribution missing; sentence about 'MAGA politics' is inference not in sources; sentence about 'collector's item' is speculation; four short sentences in paragraph 3 violate rhythm rule; paragraph 3 ends with evaluative summary; multiple sentences use loaded language ('worst possible news', 'blows me away'); facts list contains invented framing; context contains invented connection to Musk's political rise not directly stated as causal in sources
